audit.back_translation: A fraction has a numerator above a non-zero denominator. The denominator names the equal parts. The numerator counts these parts. If you reduce both numbers by their greatest common denominator, the value remains unchanged.

back_sample.translation: A fraction has a numerator above a non-zero denominator. The denominator names the equal parts. The numerator counts these parts. If you reduce both numbers by their greatest common denominator, the value remains unchanged.

candidate.raw_translation: En bråkdel har en täljare ovanför en nämnare som inte är noll. Nämnaren namnger de lika stora delarna. Täljaren räknar dessa delar. Om man reducerar båda talen med deras största gemensamma nämnare förblir värdet oförändrat.
candidate.source: A fraction has a numerator above a nonzero denominator. The denominator names the equal-sized parts. The numerator counts those parts. Reducing both numbers by their greatest common divisor keeps the value unchanged. A positive denominator makes signs easier to compare.
